credit_metrics.text: EBITDA increased by {{ebitda.change@FY2024}} to {{ebitda@FY2024}}, but operating profit fell by {{operating_profit.change@FY2024}} to {{operating_profit@FY2024}} as depreciation rose and impairment tests on equity-accounted holdings led to a charge.
Total debt rose by {{total_debt.change@FY2024}} to {{total_debt@FY2024}}, so gross leverage fell only to {{gross_leverage@FY2024}} and net leverage held at {{net_leverage@FY2024}}.
Interest coverage improved to {{interest_coverage@FY2024}}, up {{interest_coverage.change@FY2024}} on the prior year.
FFO was stable at {{ffo@FY2024}}, so FFO to debt held at {{ffo_to_debt@FY2024}}, while FCF to debt fell by {{fcf_to_debt.change@FY2024}} to {{fcf_to_debt@FY2024}}.

liquidity_funding.text: Cash and cash-like investments fell by {{cash_like.change@FY2024}} to {{cash_like@FY2024}}, so cash liquidity to revenue declined by {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.change@FY2024}} to {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2024}}.
The group issued a bond in May 2024, whose proceeds are reported among the year's cash flows, alongside operating cash flow of the year.
Total debt rose by {{total_debt.change@FY2024}} to {{total_debt@FY2024}}, so the cash buffer now covers a smaller share of the debt stack than a year earlier.

operating_performance.text: Passengers at the Paris airports reached {{passengers@FY2024}} in FY2024.

Revenue grew by {{revenue.change@FY2024}} to {{revenue@FY2024}}, faster than EBITDA, which rose by {{ebitda.change@FY2024}} to {{ebitda@FY2024}}, so the EBITDA margin narrowed by {{ebitda_margin.change@FY2024}} to {{ebitda_margin@FY2024}}.
Capex intensity rose by {{capex_intensity.change@FY2024}} to {{capex_intensity@FY2024}}, reflecting the investment programme across the Paris platform and the international portfolio.

In October 2024 the group acquired Paris Experience Group and P/S, extending the Extime offering beyond the Paris airports, and since July 2024 it holds a lower economic interest in GMR Airports after the merger of the Indian entities.

peer_positioning.text: Groupe ADP has the weakest EBITDA margin of the airport peers ({{ebitda_margin.peer_rank@FY2024}}), at {{ebitda_margin@FY2024}} against a median of {{ebitda_margin.peer_median@FY2024}}.

Leverage is the weakest in the group, with net leverage of {{net_leverage@FY2024}} against a median of {{net_leverage.peer_median@FY2024}} ({{net_leverage.peer_rank@FY2024}}) and gross leverage of {{gross_leverage@FY2024}} against {{gross_leverage.peer_median@FY2024}}.

Cash generation also lags, with FFO to debt of {{ffo_to_debt@FY2024}} and FCF to debt of {{fcf_to_debt@FY2024}} below peer medians of {{ffo_to_debt.peer_median@FY2024}} and {{fcf_to_debt.peer_median@FY2024}}, while cash liquidity to revenue sits in the middle of the group.

snapshot.text: Groupe ADP, the Paris airport group with international operations through TAV Airports and GMR Airports, grew revenue by {{revenue.change@FY2024}} to {{revenue@FY2024}} in FY2024, while the EBITDA margin narrowed by {{ebitda_margin.change@FY2024}} to {{ebitda_margin@FY2024}}.
Net leverage was broadly unchanged at {{net_leverage@FY2024}}, as net debt rose by {{net_debt.change@FY2024}} to {{net_debt@FY2024}} and gross leverage eased to {{gross_leverage@FY2024}}.

The point to watch is cash generation: free cash flow fell by {{fcf.change@FY2024}} to {{fcf@FY2024}} as capex intensity rose by {{capex_intensity.change@FY2024}} to {{capex_intensity@FY2024}}, leaving cash liquidity to revenue down by {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.change@FY2024}} to {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2024}}.

watch_items.text: Cash generation: free cash flow fell by {{fcf.change@FY2024}} to {{fcf@FY2024}} and FCF to debt dropped by {{fcf_to_debt.change@FY2024}} to {{fcf_to_debt@FY2024}}, well below the peer median of {{fcf_to_debt.peer_median@FY2024}}.

Investment: capex intensity rose by {{capex_intensity.change@FY2024}} to {{capex_intensity@FY2024}}, above the peer median of {{capex_intensity.peer_median@FY2024}}, which keeps pressure on free cash flow.

Liquidity: cash and cash-like investments fell by {{cash_like.change@FY2024}} to {{cash_like@FY2024}}, taking cash liquidity to revenue down by {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.change@FY2024}} to {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2024}}.

Leverage: net leverage of {{net_leverage@FY2024}} is above the peer median of {{net_leverage.peer_median@FY2024}} and the weakest of the group, with net debt up {{net_debt.change@FY2024}} to {{net_debt@FY2024}}.
